sources.observation: The daylight dome is pale and not tinted by the colored uplights. Wide dark metal rings separate the tiers. The lowest tier is a diagonal steel gallery. The convention hall roof steps up several metres toward the eastern end.

sources.credit: Wikimedia Commons contributor, see linked file for license
sources.observation: The caps of the overhanging ledges are slim, and recessed translucent panels show a diagonal structure behind them.
A slender glazed canopy and vertical framed glazing continue along the main south lobby. The entrance canopy shelters a recessed set of doors and stops at the ground-level plaza.

limitations: The dome envelope reaches the documented 46 m height. Individual rim spacing, steel diagonals, lobby subdivisions and canopy dimensions are estimated from photographs. The dome uses its daylight finish.
